faq_heading: Homes near Devon Gardens Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Devon Gardens Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Devon Gardens Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Devon Gardens Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Devon Gardens Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 56 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,157,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Devon Gardens Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Devon Gardens Elementary the median was 36 days on the market, closing at 95.0% of the list price, with 2% of sales above the list price for the 56 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Devon Gardens Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Gibson Elementary (0.7 km north-east), Annieville Elementary (0.8 km north-east) and Home Quest (0.8 km north-east).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Devon Gardens Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Devon Gardens Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Devon Gardens Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Devon Gardens Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Devon Gardens Elementary in a straight line (13 elementary, 6 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is Gibson Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Jarvis Traditional Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Delview Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Immaculate Conception School (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Richardson Elementary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Gibson Elementary (0.7 km north-east), Annieville Elementary (0.8 km north-east), Brooke Elementary (0.8 km west), Hellings Elementary (1.1 km south-east), Richardson Elementary (1.1 km south). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Gibson Elementary, 0.7 km north-east of Devon Gardens Elementary.
